name: Pencil
specialText: Special: Erase — 10 Ink, removes a debuff from you.
flavor: Property of Room 204. Do not remove.

name: Mechanical Pencil
specialText: Special: Click — 12 Ink, guarantees a crit on the next hit.
flavor: Lead refills sold separately. Forever.

name: Red Pen
specialText: Special: Mark Down — 16 Ink, applies 2 ink stains.
flavor: Grading is not personal. It only feels that way.

name: Permanent Marker
specialText: Special: Smear — 14 Ink, leaves a slow patch.
flavor: Permanent means permanent. Ask the desk.

name: Highlighter
specialText: Special: Highlight — 10 Ink, marks enemies so they take +15% for 6s.
flavor: Yellow is the only colour the school approved.

name: Wax Crayon
specialText: Special: Colour Outside — 8 Ink, a wide harmless arc that pushes enemies.
flavor: Sharpener not included. Nothing is.

name: Pink Eraser
specialText: Special: Rub Out — 12 Ink, blinds an enemy for 3s.
flavor: It only erases mistakes. Yours.

name: Glue Stick
specialText: Special: Stick — 14 Ink, roots an enemy for 1.2s.
flavor: Non-toxic. Probably.

name: Rubber Cement
specialText: Special: Vulcanise — 20 Ink, glues two enemies together.
flavor: Ventilation is a suggestion.

name: Scissors
specialText: Special: Snip — 14 Ink, +1 pierce for the next 3 attacks.
flavor: Left-handed pair. Nobody knows why.

name: Safety Scissors
specialText: Special: Blunt Tip — 8 Ink, cannot crit, but never misses.
flavor: Rounded for your protection. Not theirs.

name: Ruler
specialText: Special: Measure Twice — 10 Ink, next attack deals double to a full-HP enemy.
flavor: 30 cm. It has been used for other things.

name: Protractor
specialText: Special: Arc — 16 Ink, thrown arc that hits twice.
flavor: Do not use as a Frisbee. Again.

name: Drafting Compass
specialText: Special: Perfect Circle — 20 Ink, spins for 3 hits around you.
flavor: Point is very sharp. That is the whole warning.

name: Stapler
specialText: Special: Double Tap — 16 Ink, staples twice.
flavor: Property of Room 204. Do not remove.

name: Staple Gun (Jammed)
specialText: Special: Jam — 18 Ink, fires a three-staple burst.
flavor: The jam is structural now.

name: Hole Punch
specialText: Special: Two Holes — 14 Ink, punches through to a second enemy.
flavor: Heavier than it looks. Much.

name: Binder Clip
specialText: Special: Pinch — 8 Ink, briefly staggers.
flavor: Holds things together. Including grudges.

name: Paper Clip
specialText: Special: Unbend — 6 Ink, a long poke.
flavor: One of ten thousand. It knows.

name: Rubber Band
specialText: Special: Flick — 6 Ink, a stinging shot.
flavor: Do not aim at faces. That is the only rule.

name: Slingshot
specialText: Special: Bank Shot — 12 Ink, bounces once off a wall.
flavor: Confiscated eleven times. Returned eleven times.

name: Taped Ruler
specialText: Special: Extension — 10 Ink, reach increases for 5s.
flavor: Rule #1 of the hallway: do not break the ruler.

name: Textbook
specialText: Special: Pop Quiz — 18 Ink, ask a question: correct answer stuns.
flavor: Volume II. Volume I is missing.

name: Dictionary
specialText: Special: Define — 22 Ink, a word so heavy it knocks enemies back.
flavor: Contains every word except the ones you need.

name: Clipboard
specialText: Special: Check Off — 10 Ink, marks an enemy for +15% damage taken.
flavor: The list of names keeps getting longer.

name: Calculator
specialText: Special: Divide — 12 Ink, splits damage between two enemies.
flavor: No graphing. No games. It still counts.

name: Lab Beaker
specialText: Special: Pour — 16 Ink, spills a burning pool.
flavor: Contents labelled in handwriting nobody can read.

name: Test Tube Rack
specialText: Special: Shatter — 20 Ink, glass shards fly outward.
flavor: Six tubes. Two of them are still warm.

name: Bunsen Burner (Capped)
specialText: Special: Blue Flame — 24 Ink, a cone of fire for 2s.
flavor: The cap is on. The cap has always been on.

name: Glue-Stick Bomb
specialText: Special: Splatter — 22 Ink, throws a sticky blast.
flavor: Do not shake. Do not stop shaking.

name: Mop
specialText: Special: Swab — 8 Ink, pushes enemies in a line.
flavor: The floor has been clean for years. It is still not.

name: Broom
specialText: Special: Sweep — 12 Ink, wide knockback sweep.
flavor: Do not ask where the dust goes.

name: Dodgeball
specialText: Special: Dodge This — 12 Ink, bounces between enemies.
flavor: If you can dodge a wrench, you can dodge a test.

name: Gym Javelin
specialText: Special: Hurl — 24 Ink, a full-power throw that pierces.
flavor: Track and field has not been the same since.

name: Lunch Tray
specialText: Special: Block — 12 Ink, reduces incoming damage by 60% for 1s.
flavor: Mystery loaf residue is permanent.

name: Metal Thermos
specialText: Special: Slosh — 14 Ink, spills hot soup in front of you.
flavor: Still warm. Nobody saw it filled.

name: Dry-Erase Board
specialText: Special: Wipe — 18 Ink, clears projectiles around you.
flavor: Today's lesson: run.

name: Chalk Stub
specialText: Special: Dust — 8 Ink, a puff that reduces enemy accuracy.
flavor: Squeaks when it is afraid.

name: Overstuffed Binder
specialText: Special: Due Today — 26 Ink, slams everything in front of you.
flavor: Every assignment. Every year. Still not handed in.

name: The Substitute's Pen
specialText: Special: Mark Absent — 24 Ink, executes enemies below 20% HP.
flavor: It writes your name before you say it.

name: Cardboard Chest Guard
specialText: Armor 4. Chemical damage -10%.
flavor: Reinforced with tape. Emotionally.

name: Textbook Vest
specialText: Armor 12. Blunt damage -20%. Dodge is slower.
flavor: Heavy reading. Literally.

name: Lab Apron
specialText: Armor 6. Chemical damage -35%.
flavor: Somebody's name is embroidered inside. Not yours.

name: Lunch Tray Buckler
specialText: Armor 8. Ranged damage -25%.
flavor: Deflects dodgeballs and consequences.
